kangaroo-at-2020-junior-01.prompt: When the results of the following additions are written in descending order, what sum will be in the middle?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-03.prompt: When Cosme correctly wears his new shirt, as shown on the left figure, the horizontal stripes form seven closed arches around his body. This morning he buttoned his shirt in the wrong way, as shown on the right. How many open arches were there around Cosme's body this morning?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-04.prompt: Four integer numbers have sum $S$ and product 9. What is the lowest possible value for $S$?
kangaroo-at-2020-junior-04.reviewNote: The official 2020 key lists (B) for this question, which does not fit this (Brazil second-application) version: the correct answer is (C). Answer set to (C); please check.

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-05.prompt: Maria has ten pieces of paper. Some are square and the others are triangles. She cuts each square along one of its diagonals. She then counts the total number of vertices of the pieces she has now and gets 48. How many squares did she have before making the cuts?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-06.prompt: In the addition shown, different letters represent different digits and equal letters represent equal digits. The resulting sum is a number of four digits, B being different from zero. What is the sum of the digits of this number?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-07.prompt: The digits of the year 2020 consist of two different digits, each repeated twice. How many years since the year 1000 until now (2020) have this property?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-08.prompt: There are several figures that can be formed by nine squares of 1 cm side by side (see an example in the picture) and one of them has the biggest perimeter. What is this perimeter?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-09.prompt: Four points were marked on a grid of 1 cm side squares. Of the possible triangular regions that can be obtained with vertices in three of these points, one has the largest area. What is this area, in cm²?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-10.prompt: Martinho made a bicolour kite with six pieces of a thin strip of bamboo. Two pieces were used for the diagonals, which are perpendicular. The other four pieces were used to connect the middle points on the sides of the kite, as shown in the picture. What is the ratio between the blue and yellow parts of the kite?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-11.prompt: Adam, Breno and Carlos live in the same apartment and bought a treadmill for exercise. Nobody uses the treadmill on Wednesdays and Sundays and there is no day the three of them use the treadmill. Adam uses the treadmill 4 times a week and Breno 5 times a week. There are 4 consecutive days when Adam uses the treadmill on the first day, he does not use it on the second day and Breno does not use it on the fourth day. Carlos uses the treadmill on one day of the week. Which day?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-12.prompt: Integers $a$, $b$, $c$ and $d$ satisfy the equality $2ab = 3cd$. Which of the following numbers can be the product $abcd$?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-13.prompt: The shortest way from Atown to Cetown is through Betown. Going along this road we first find the signposts on the left side of the picture. Further on we find the road signs on the right side of the picture. How far is it from Betown to Atown?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-14.prompt: Two isosceles triangles which are not similar have at least one side of 20 cm and have equal perimeters. If one of them has a side of 8 cm, which of the following measures can be the measure of one side of the other triangle?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-15.prompt: Toninho wants to write strictly positive and consecutive whole numbers in the nine places of the figure, so that the sum of the three numbers in each diameter is equal to 24. What is the largest possible sum for all the nine numbers?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-16.prompt: Marta observed that the number 2020 has the following property: the number formed by the two digits on the left is equal to the number formed by the two digits on the right. How many four-digit numbers, including 2020, have this same property?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-17.prompt: Two circles are tangent to each other and also to two sides of a square. What is the measure of the angle $A\hat{O}B$, determined by three of these points of tangency, as shown in the figure?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-18.prompt: Roberto and Maria leave at the same time from the same point of a long circular track, he on foot and she by bike. Maria completes a lap 24 minutes before Roberto and waits for him while having an ice cream. When he reaches this point, Maria leaves with her bike in the opposite direction and Roberto continues walking without stopping in the same direction. Then they meet 5 minutes later. Assuming the speeds are kept constant, how long does it take for Roberto to walk one lap of the track?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-19.prompt: Let $17x + 51y = 102$. If $x$ and $y$ are strictly positive integers, what is the value of $x - 3y$?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-20.prompt: Ana plays with $n \times n$ boards by placing a token in some cells so that no two cells containing tokens have a common point. The picture shows how to place as many tokens as possible on $5\times5$ and $6\times6$ boards. In this way, how many tokens can Ana put at most on a $2020\times2020$ board?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-21.prompt: The window shown is a square of area 1 m² and is composed of four triangles, whose areas, indicated in the figure, satisfy $3A = 4B$ and $2C = 3D$. A fly is placed exactly at the point where these four triangles touch each other. The fly flies directly to the side of the window closest to it. How far does it fly?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-22.prompt: Julia puts the nine chips shown in a box. She then takes one chip at a time, without looking, and notes down its digit, obtaining, at the end, a number of nine different digits. What is the probability that the number written by Julia is divisible by 45?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-23.prompt: A rectangular sheet with one side of 12 cm is folded along its 20 cm diagonal. What is the overlapping area of the folded parts, indicated in grey in the picture?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-24.prompt: Carlos always tells the truth on alternate days. On the other days, he tells only lies. Today he made exactly four of the five statements that follow. Which one was not made today by him?

choices.text: The number of male and female friends I have is a prime number.
The number of male friends I have is equal to the number of female friends I have.
Three of my male friends are older than me.

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-25.prompt: Julia wrote four positive integers, one at each vertex of a triangular-based pyramid. She calculated the sum of the numbers written on the vertices of one face and the product of the numbers written on the vertices of two other faces, obtaining 15, 20 and 30, respectively. What is the highest possible value of the product of the four numbers?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-26.prompt: Pedro assembled a cube using 64 little white equal cubes and then he painted the cube red. Then he dismantled the cube and reassembled it so that all its faces were white and painted the cube red again. How many faces of little cubes remained white?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-27.prompt: Ana wants to write positive whole numbers, one in each of the empty squares shown, so that the sums of the four numbers in each row and the four numbers in each column are equal. She has already written some numbers, as shown. She wants to write the missing numbers so that the sum of the missing numbers is as small as possible. What is this sum?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-28.prompt: A large rectangular plot is divided into two lots that are separated from each other by a fence ABCD, as shown in the picture. The parts AB, BC and CD of this fence are parallel to the sides of the rectangle and have lengths of 30 m, 24 m and 10 m, respectively. The owners of these lands have agreed to knock down the fence and make a new straight fence AE, without changing the area of each of the lands. How far from point D should the end E of the fence be?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-29.prompt: The number $K = 99\ldots9$ is formed by $n$ digits 9. What is the sum of the digits of the number $K^3$?

kangaroo-at-2020-junior-30.prompt: On the $8 \times 8$ board shown, in how many ways can you place two chips, one green and one red, in cells of different colours, so that the chips are not in the same row or in the same column of the board?
